description.text: B.A. Insurance Objectives: This program trains students with the theories of insurance and skills of professional transactions. Graduates are fit for jobs in insurance companies, insurance inter-firms, financial organizations and enterprises covering the fields of insurance management, insurance financial planning and risk management. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main Courses: Monetary and Banking, Management, Economic Law, Public Finance, Risk Management, Principles of Insurance, Operation and Management of Insurance Companies, Properties Insurance, Life Insurance, Accuracy Mathematics, Insurance Accounting, Insurance Marketing, Re-Insurance, Ocean Insurance, Law of Insurance, Insurance Investment, Financial Management, etc.

duration.text: The Insurance at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
